Speed Run Walkthrough

The fastest way to reach Volcano Manor is by either doing Rya's questline or following Patches instructions and getting kidnaped by Abductor Virgin underneath Raya Lucaria Academy water wheel lift, beating the Abductor Virgins boss and heading north through a narrow opening at the Seethewater River site of grace.

This speed run walkthrough will assume you're systematically completing the areas in The Lands Between and that at this point you don't have access to the Mountaintop of the Giants yet. With this assumption, we will be skipping the Volcano Manor assassination quests and heading straight for Rykard through the secret passageway. Keep in mind that defeating Rykard locks you out of these quests, as well as the NPC quests of the Volcano Manor inhabitants.

Speak to Tanith and join the Volcano Manor for her to give you the Drawing-Room Key. With the key in hand, head through the hallway in the west, and open the first door to your right. Attack the wall behind the corpse to reveal a secret passageway and head through it until you reach a room with two ways forward. If you fancy yourself the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (21) and the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes, head through the doorway on the left and make sure to reveal the hidden doorway left of the corpse at the dead end. Otherwise, head down the flight of stairs and past the Bloodhound Knight to get to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace.

Upon leaving the church, turn right and scale the rooftops, following the enemies until you can safely drop down to a flight of stone stairs facing west. At the imp statue, turn left and when you get to the Man-Serpent guarding the door, circle round the left of the building to get inside. Head downstairs, where you'll find the Guest Hall Site of Grace in one of the rooms.

From this room go back, to one room and head out through the closed door. To your right is a ladder going down, after which you should head east to ascend a flight of stairs. Ignore the Man-Serpent and get straight into the cage lift immediately in front of you to take you up to the next floor. Continue forward ascending another flight of steps and before you enter the temple, turn around to your left to make a shortcut back here.

Enter the temple to fight the Godskin Noble and acquire the Godskin Stitcher and Noble Presence incantation. After interacting with the Site of Grace, turn right and take the elevator up. Right ahead is a balcony. Jump over the banister down to the cliffs and follow the Burning Slug path. When you get to a corpse sitting by the cliff's edge, turn left and jump to the ledge below, once again following the path until you find a building with an open window.

In this room, there is a ladder you can go down to reach the Missionary's Cookbook (6) in a jail cell. When you've got that, return up the ladder. Head through the door to the west, cross the bridge, go up the stairs and when you're in the building, turn right, going forward until you get to a Man-Serpent with a fiery whip. Head through the door behind him then take the next door to your right. On the altar is the Man-Serpent Ashes. Run past the enemies, heading up both flights of stairs, and you'll find a waygate on a balcony.

Take the waygate and you'll be teleported to the Site of Grace right outside the fog door to the God-Devouring Serpent/Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy boss fight. When you enter the fog door, immediately take and equip the Serpent-Hunter to your left. This spear has special properties during this boss fight that makes its range longer. After the first phase, the God-Devouring Serpent is defeated, you'll fight Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy straight after. Defeat the boss and you'll be rewarded with the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, Rykard's Great Rune, and the Eye Surcoat. Grab the Site of Grace that spawns here too

If you'd like extra quick loot, you can head back to the NPCs and speak to them. They'll disappear from the location after reloading the area. Head upstairs to fight Inquisitor Ghiza and acquire Ghiza's Wheel, as well as a Smithing Stone [6] on a corpse nearby. Teleport back to the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace. Attack Tanith here and fight her knight to earn her clothing set, Consort's Set, and the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath incantation

Volcano Manor Trivia

  • A couple of illusory doors have been discovered in Volcano Manor that require multiple (roughly 50) hits to open. It is assumed that these are the result of developer oversight, as they have 9999 health (this is the same for all illusory doors; they are usually killed by the game once interacted with) and do not play any of the audio/visual cues. These doors additionally all lead to previously accessible areas. These have been patched out as of v1.04.


Elden Ring Walkthrough - Leyndell, Royal Capital

Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Leyndell, Royal Capital Points of Interest

  • Defeat Tree Sentinel duo
  • Collect Map & Golden Seed
  • Complete Sealed Tunnel
  • Collect Golden Seeds & Fight Margit
  • Complete events in Hermit Merchant's Shack
  • Loot Flask Upgrades
  • Visit Blackguard Big Boggart
  • Complete Auriza Hero's Grave & Auriza Side Tomb
  • Defeat Draconic Tree Sentinel
  • Compete Leyndell, Royal Capital

Elden Ring Map: Leyndell Royal Capital Starting Point. There are two ways to access Leyndell, Royal Capital, but we will approach it from South to North to procure the map fragment as soon as possible. You will thus begin from the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, and take the large bridge up to the gates. Here you will have a duo of Tree Sentinel bosses that drop the Erdtree Greatshield. They are optional, so you can run by and get to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace instead. Here you can collect 2x Golden Seed and Map (Leyndell, Royal Capital). ( Elden Ring Map Link)

From this site of grace, if you go south, you will come to the Minor Ertree Church ( Elden Ring Map Link) and can loot Missionary's Cookbook [4] as well as the Golden Order Seal. From here, we will travel north and slightly east and down into the watery area. On the southern point of it, there's the "Sealed Tunnel", which requires you to hit an illusory wall to enter. ( Elden Ring Map Link)

Sealed Tunnel

Sealed Tunnel Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Even though it looks like a "Sealed" Tunnel as its name says, there's a cavity that will open a secret path if you attack it. There are many Miners that can be easily surprised as they are working. The mine keeps hiding paths, the second one is behind the chest that contains Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (2). You will find an elevator right after that and you will notice when you go down, that there are some areas to discover the middle way down. It's very safe to jump in those areas, as you can jump your way down whenever you need to return to the main way, as there are some platforms and wooden structures that will ease the fall.

Once down, at the end of the path, there's another illusory wall, followed by another one with a Golden Rune (5) in front of it. This next area is much bigger. Try to stay up on the wooden platforms and take out the enemies there, in the pit below there is an Abductor Virgin waiting. There is a path to the right containing a Stonesword Key. On the roots going across there is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot. In the pit below, try to lure out the abductor virgin to break the statue which contains three Smithing Stones (6). There is also a Rune Arc, Golden Run (1), three Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and a Somber Smithing Stone (5) on the wall.

At the very end of the path, there's an Abnormal Stone Cluster ready to explode behind some debris, in a very dark cavity. Behind it, there's another illusory wall. Follow through and climb over the roots to reach another area to dropdown. Be careful and keep easing your fall by falling short distances. Once you have reached the bottom, you will see an arena that contains the boss fight against Onyx Lord who drops the Onyx Lord's Greatsword.

Divine Tower of West Altus

Divine Tower of West Altus Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

The point of this tunnel (besides the loot) is that it acts as a passageway to the Divine Tower of West Altus, where you can activate Rykard's Rune ( Elden Ring Map Link). If you don't have it yet you will have to come back later. Reach this tower after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy at the Volcano Manor and obtaining Rykard's Great Rune [ Elden Ring Map Link] to restore its power. Choose to reach this location before this event and you will instead be greeted with its tightly blocked shut doors.

The entrance to the Divine Tower is hidden and can only be found by going through a series of illusory walls and to defeat Onyx Lord in the Sealed Tunnel. (Follow the Sealed Tunnel Guide to reach this area.) Once you reach the tower, step to the center of the tower platform to ascend. Take the stairs up wrapping around the exterior of the tower to eventually reach. Here, you can restore the power of the Great Rune.

Exploring the Capital

Return to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace and take the road North. You can opt to fight a Gargoyle or press forward until you see another Golden Seed and the Palm Reader of this area ( Elden Ring Map Link. A teardrop scarab nearby will drop you Ash of War: Golden Parry. Take the road northwest from this point and listen for a familiar voice saying "I see you, tarnished". This is Margit, who will drop the Viridian Amber Medallion +1 if defeated. Press on along the road and activate the Outer Wall Battleground site of grace.

You will now want to turn eastward until you find a road heading further east. If you take a small detour north on this road, you can follow it on a u-turn to arrive at the Hermit Merchant's Shack ( Elden Ring Map Link). There's a merchant here as well as two nighttime invasions: Bell Bearing Hunter (drops Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing) and Deathbird (drops Twinbird Kite Shield). From here, we'll take the road east and north. Don't go to the Minor Ertree yet, as an altar at the top of the road has the Winged Crystal Tear. After collecting, visit the Minor Erdtree and loot Twiggy Cracked Tear and Crimson Crystal Tear.

  1. Travel directly south until you see a moat at the base of the wall. If you followed the instructions in Liurnia and talked to this merchant, you will now meet Blackguard Big Boggart. You can purchase Boiled Crab from him. This moat will also have an invasion from Dung Eater if you have advanced the Roundtable Hold quest with him.
  2. Follow the path east from here and the road will diverge north and south. To the South, you can take on Auriza Hero's Grave and loot several heavy armor and weapons. To the north, Auriza Side Tomb has the Soldjars of Fortune Ashes that summons "potboys" to fight alongside you as well as Grave Glovewort (5), (6) and Ghost Glovewort (6) and the Perfumer's Cookbook (3).
  3. Turn back toward the Minor Erdtree and return to the main higher road. This time follow the higher path east until it turns into an open-field boss fight with the Draconic Tree Sentinel. Defeating this boss will reward you with Dragon Greatclaw, Dragonclaw Shield, and access to the Legacy Dungeon of this area: Leyndell, Capital City. The path within the legacy dungeon is challenging so you should upgrade everything that you can and optimize your setup before heading in.

Auriza Hero's Grave Walkthrough

Auriza Heros' Grave Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Before heading here, make sure you have one Stonesword Key ready to use on an Imp Statue ( Elden Ring Map Link). Upon arriving, you'll find the Site of Grace for this location. On the left side of an altar, you'll see an arch doorway that is blocked by a white fog. Use the Stonesword Key on the Imp Statue and inside that room, you'll encounter two Basilisk enemies. There's a corpse here that you can loot to find the Golden Epitaph weapon.

Now head west where you'll need to traverse some slopes that head down to the lower section of this location. As you move towards the slope, a large environmental hazard, a chariot will appear. This isn't the only chariot that will appear, but there will be multiple ones as you progress. If you need to move fast, try wearing light armor or equipping them first until you reach the end of this section. On this first slope sprint down and about halfway, move to the corner on the left or right to take cover. There will be two Skeleton enemies that will reanimate when you come around the corner depending on the section you dive into. Wait for the chariot to move past you and run down till you reach the first set of pillars and arches. Stand directly under this arch for now.

Next, you'll have to go up a second slope. The two chariots won't hit you if you're standing in between the pillars. Wait for the second chariot to go up, move up along with it, and roll or move towards the corner on the left. When it moves down, quickly duck into a safe spot as it approaches. Keep right. For the third slope, you'll notice that this slope is wide compared to the first two. There are two chariots on the third slope that simultaneously moves up and down. Examine how both chariots move so that you know which way to move.

As you go down the third slope, you'll notice that there is a gap that you can drop to. If you keep right, you can drop down to a safe spot. Use this to take cover. You'll find a body here that can be looted to find x1 Stonesword Key and x1 Ghost Glovewort [6] that is guarded by a single Skeleton enemy. As you continue heading down, if you need to take cover, just near the end of the slope, there's another corner on the left side that you can use to take cover, but there's another Skeleton enemy here that will ambush you.

Make your way to the next row of pillars. As for the next slope that also goes down, keep an eye again for the other two chariots, sprint in a zig-zag direction, and stand in between the pillars (you won't get hit here). Notice as well that there is a body hanging by the edge of the slope on the left, loot it to find x1 Golden Rune [7]. You should still be near the row of pillars.

Vulgar Militia Ashes

Use the body as an indication of where to drop below. Before jumping, you'll notice the thin wooden plank structures over the large drop. This is where you'll be dropping. Drop down the first short plank then onto the lower longer one directly underneath. Then you'll want to drop to the perpendicular plank and walk along it. You'll find the ashes here and another lower plank at the end perpendicular to the one you're on. Drop down one last time and make your way into the next area that it leads to. You should see a statue. Clear the toads in the area and you'll come across a corpse where you can loot Vulgar Militia Ashes. This area will also be filled with Basilisk Creatures.

Return to the wooden beams over the large drop. You should be able to drop down one more level onto the narrow stone arches. Follow the narrow route to the end. This area will have one large archway and a ladder. Ascend the ladder and you'll find yourself with another chariot at the end of the tunnel. There's only one short slope left that goes up. You need to take cover by using the corner on the right side and then sprint towards the door.

Dungeon Mini-Boss

Beyond the door, simply head down the steps. This section is guarded by a few Skeleton enemies, it should be easy for you to fight and pass through them. At the bottom section is a large archway that is covered with a gold mist. Beyond it serves as the arena for the bosses of this location, the Crucible Knight and Crucible Knight Ordovis. We suggest that when you are fighting them, take out the Crucible Knight first and use any of your upgraded or strong Spirit Ashes. This way, you won't have to fight the bosses on your own.

Successfully defeating them both yields 28000 Runes and rewards the Ordovis's Greatsword, as well as the Armor pieces for the Crucible Axe Set. There are some Root Resin materials that you can get in this boss arena - simply use the portal here to return to the entrance.

Clearing the Chariots

Just before the door leading towards the boss, there is a pit with some wooden planks, you can jump on them and a body hanging on the ledge tells you where to drop. After reaching the planks, go down them until you get to the stone pillars and move to the ladders. As you advance through the hallway, a chariot will spawn on the outside, as it goes down, rapidly head up the ramp and to the right to find a pillar. Hitting it will raise it to the main hallways. When you make your way back you may notice a new chariot summoning circle. This will lead the chariots to crash into each other, breaking and leaving you with a new Ash of War and the Tree Sentinel Set:

  • Ash of War: Holy Ground
  • Tree Sentinel Helm
  • Tree Sentinel Armor
  • Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
  • Tree Sentinel Greaves

Once the chariots are dead, go down the same path you took until the hall where you hit the pillar. The path downwards will be clear leading to an elevator where you can find a Ghost Glovewort [6] and towards a little room with an enemy protecting the Crucible Feather Talisman. The pillars can be moved with arrows from a distance if you prefer a safer approach to them.

Elden Ring Walkthrough - Auriza Side Tomb

Auriza Side Tomb Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Auriza Side Tomb's gimmick is its Teleporter chests porting you between inaccessible areas ( Elden Ring Map Link). Furthermore, these catacombs contain two copies of the same set of rooms which will be called areas A and B. The teleporter at the end of the chapel will always transport you to the flooded version of the room. The teleporter behind the hidden sidewall of the chapel takes you to the other version. From the side of grace at the starting area, descend from there to the room with the boss door. Below that is a room with a window where you can drop down, or you can head to the other side to find the first teleporting chest. This chest transports you to the room beneath the room with the window, not beside it, but directly below. The lower room with the window also contains a chest that returns you to your original location. There's only one exit from the room beneath the window, leading to the area you would land in if you jumped from the window. Initially, you have the option to use either method (through teleporting or jumping through the window), as they both lead to the same area. This room, aside from the high window, also features a smaller ledge above, housing the lever to open the boss door, as well as another exit leading downward.

Descending further leads you to the cells/sewer area. It's a single room divided into a larger area behind bars, inaccessible from your current position, and a ledge above where you entered. You'll find another exit on your right. This room also has a ledge above and to the righ upon entry, connecting to the ledge in the cell/sewer room. There's also a false wall on the left and a chest at the far end. This chest transports you to the opposite side of the cell/sewer room, where you'll encounter enemies and loot. The only way out is via the paired chest, which returns you to your original position. This area remains within area A.

Continue through the secret passage and you'll encounter another chest that transports you to the other room set. You'll then find yourself in a room with the hidden passage on the higher ledge within area B. The chest in this room leads you to the cell/sewer room in area B, but hold off on that for now. Instead, follow the ledge and ascend the ladder, you'll find yourself in the room accessible by jumping through the window, still within area B. While there's nothing particularly remarkable here, you can engage enemies and gather loot as you progress through the area. Now proceed to the room beneath the window room in area B, looting and defeating enemies as you go. Notably, there's no chest in this spot in area B. Return to the room with the hidden passage and use the chest at the bottom. This chest returns you to the room in area A, where the first chestt was located. From here, you can engage in combat with some more enemies and loot everything as you proceed, and then jump out the window to return to the room in area B with the secret passage and open the chest.

You'll now find yourself in area B behind the iron bars in the cells/sewer room, Eliminate all the enemies in the area, you'll also find a ladder to climb here. Climb up the ladder and you'll end up on the ledge in area A where you'll find the window you can jump through. You'll find the lever to open the boss door here. After interacting with the lever, descend and proceed up the steps to the room beneath the window room and use the chest, then retrace your steps to the boss door and prepare to face the boss, Grave Warden Duelist. There's also a few living jars in his arena that will attack you. Kill him to acquire the Soldjars of Fortune ashes.

Elden Ring Walkthrough - Completing Leyndell, Royal Capital

Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Leyndell, Royal Capital Points of Interest

  • Enter Leyndell, Roytal Capital.
  • Go to the Erdtree Sanctuary.
  • Defeat Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Golden Shade).
  • Proceed to the Queen's Bedchamber.
  • Defeat Morgott the Omen King.
  • Barrier in the Capital Outskirts is no longer.
  • Proceed to the Forbidden Lands.

Leyndell, Royal Capital

Legacy Dungeon
Location

Altus Plateau

Recommended Levels

90+

Bosses

Morgott the Omen King ◆ Godfrey, First Elden Lord

Leyndell Royal Capital (Legacy Dungeon) is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. A sprawling capital city that houses various strong enemies, as well as champions that were previously encountered. The Royal Capital of Leyndell functions as the seat of government and administrative center of Altus Plateau. For an overview of this location outside of the "dungeon", visit our location page for Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Full Leyndell, Royal Capital Walkthrough

East Capital Rampart Site

For this walkthrough, we will be providing you a guide on various sections the area, as well as indicating important loot, enemies, any NPCs, and related bosses. The Leyndell Royal Capital (Legacy Dungeon) region is only accessible to players who have gathered two Great Runes and has content for highly leveled gameplay. If you want to check a summary of the various entries found within Leyndell, Royal Capital, please visit our location page for Leyndell, Royal Capital. We will begin the walkthrough by starting your exploration at the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace Map Coordinates Here.

Exit the door through the west exit and head southeast where you'll encounter several Oracle Envoys, and one Large Oracle Envoy, which are white-colored enemies holding instruments. Eventually, before reaching the end, you'll notice a Broken Statue guarding a doorway behind it. Make sure to fight this enemy from long range since it will conjure pillars of flames that will track you. After defeating it, go through the arch doorway it was guarding to enter a study room. Inside, you'll encounter a Page. Go down to the first floor and exit the door on the right where you'll encounter three more Oracle Envoys.

Go straight and pass through the narrow runway where you'll see another Oracle Envoy at the end. Enter the door on the right side and quickly dodge or prepare to hold your shield to block the attack from the Page that is ready to ambush you. Exit the opposite door and head up the stairs. You'll find yourself back at the section where you encountered the Broken Statue - go back to the first floor of the study room (where you initially encountered the Page) and exit towards the other door that's facing west.

By the doorway, there's a lever on the left; if the elevator is not already present, pull it to call the lift. Ride the elevator down. At the bottom, you'll encounter two Commoner enemies resting by the door. Jump over the balcony to the left and onto the roof of a short building. Look down, you'll see a Leyndell Knight, take this opportunity to kill it while you are on high ground. Jump down and kill the Leyndell Foot Soldier that's resting here as well. Go north and then make a left. Next to the bodies of the Commoners, there's another doorway on the left, be cautious since another Leyndell Knight is patrolling and will eventually walk through that doorway. After killing the knight, go towards the doorway and enter a stock room filled with crates and barrels - you can break through and exit the doorway facing west.

Behind those crates and boxes blocking the doorway, there are a few more Commoners sitting by the hall, as well as more around this section. Go up the stairs, exit to the balcony, and enter the doorway on the right side of the balcony. In that room, you'll notice another Perfumer sitting at the center, next to some Commoners. You can sneak behind to backstab it. You'll notice that if you exit the doorway ahead, you'll find yourself back at the starting point from the lift you rode earlier. Within this octagon shaped room is a ladder, climb it. At the top you can claim a Perfume Bottle in a chest. Continue up the spiral staircase to get a Seedbed Curse.

From the middle level, exit to a balcony and fight two Perfumers and two Commoners. Proceed carefully, there's a Page on your left waiting to ambush. From here you can drop down to an area you've been before -- the first elevator.

Go back into the room with the ladder and exit to the west, passing a number of resting Commoners. Go down the stairs and turn west, exiting into a small garden that is guarded by a single Page. Walk towards the left side corner of the fence and you'll see that you can jump over it to go down. As you walk around the corner, you'll encounter two Rotten Strays on the right, eating a corpse that's holding an item, and another hiding by the corner on the left. Kill the Rotten Strays and loot the body to find 3x Old Fangs.

Next, head northwest towards the capital's main grounds where you'll see an Erdtree Avatar that will appear. Defeating it will give you a Lord's Rune and 10062 runes. Or, you can hide behind cover and wait for it to walk past you so you can sneak past, just keep an eye out because it will walk back. Past where the Erdtree Avatar appeared, there's a golden doorway with 2 flags and 2 firestands -- through there is the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace.

East Capital Rampart - Rooftops

Note that some of the loot in the area is only accessible via the rooftops. From the East Capital Rampart site of grace, head toward the Broken Statue. From the level below it, you can see an Imp hanging on the ledge. Jump down to the roof below. There will be many Imps on the rooftops and you will frequently need to make careful running jumps over the gaps between roofs. Following the path marked by where there are Imps, you will find a Stonesword Key, a Golden Rune (9), and a Golden Rune [12]. From these rooftops you will see an otherwise-inaccessible alley. There's a Leyndell Knight looking at a waxed-shut door and a corpse with a Smithing Stone [6] that you can see from the roofs. Jump down and you'll find another Golden Rune (9). From here there's a couple spots you can jump down into the alleys across the road from the fountain.

Avenue Balcony Site

Head back to the road, there's a body lying on a short set of stairs that can be looted to find 3x Gold Firefly. On the other side of the large carriage that's on the right (the one that's standing, not the one that's tilted over), you'll find another corpse; loot it to find a Golden Rune [9]. Up the stairs east from this carriage, there's a sitting Leyndell Knight. After defeating it, there's an alley on the right with Fan Daggers. Beware the Leyndell Foot Soldier who will ambush you as you grab them, and be aware of the Imp on the roof above that may attack if the sounds of your fighting alert it. Continuing this way takes you back to the area from earlier with the two Leyndell Knights.

Head back down to the tilted carriage by where the Erdtree Avatar appeared (it has an corpse with an item on it). Go up the set of stairs behind it, make the first hard left and you'll see two Leyndell Foot Soldiers, another Perfumer next to a gazebo, and a Leyndell Soldier on the right side. Kill the enemies, check behind the chalice statue to find a Smithing Stone [4] that is looted off a corpse, and jump over the fence to land on the carriage and loot the body here to find 1x Holy Grease.

Go up the next set of stairs, kill the two Leyndell Soldiers that are chit-chatting, and check the alleyway first, ahead of the two soldiers. By the dead-end, there's another corpse you can pillage to find a Golden Rune [8]. Go back, check the east side where you'll bump into two more Leyndell Foot Soldiers guarding by the short steps, along with another Leyndell Soldier.

As you head down, you'll notice another Broken Statue enemy ahead. Kill it and loot the bodies that are around to find the following items, one Golden Rune [11], one Golden Rune [8], and one Somber Smithing Stone [5].

Head back across to the other side of the bridge. You'll encounter three Leyndell Soldiers and two patrolling Leyndell Knights, then a Leyndell Soldier with two Leyndell Foot Soldiers. Beyond them is a Lion Guardian and a Perfumer guarding two items. You'll reach a dead-end at a broken bridge.

Avenue Balcony - Northeast

Now explore the northeast section. Go to the main avenue where you encountered the Erdtree Avatar. Proceed northeast, picking up a Golden Rune [9] if you haven't yet from the body that's beside the Carriage's wheels.

Continue northeast, then head right into the side streets, alleys, and shadowy nooks across the road from the fountain. Beware the Leyndell Knight and numerous Leyndell Soldiers and Leyndell Foot Soldiers. You'll find 3x Arteria Leaf and the Imp Head (Corpse).

Now head across the street to the area with a fountain. Investigate the doorway on the right, where you'll encounter a lesser variant of Crucible Knight Ordovis that's standing next to an altar inside a room. Kill it and loot the Hero's Rune [5] and Golden Rune [9] in the room. Pass through the short hallway, make a right and ride the elevator up - open the door and you'll unlock a shortcut leading back to the East Capital Rampart site.

Avenue Balcony - Lower Capital

There are two ways to get to the lower section of Leyndell: the elevator down from the fountain and the ladder down from the sewers. This walkthrough starts at the fountain and ends at the sewers.

Back at the fountain, enter the other doorway; in that room is another lift that will take you down to the lower area of Leyndell. From the bottom of the elevator ride, exit the doorway and go down the stairs where you'll encounter three Putrid Corpses. Use caution, you'll be ambushed by one on your right. After defeating the first three Putrid Corpses and picking up a Golden Rune [9], there will be three more down an alley guarding 1x Gravel Stone. Next, kill another Putrid Corpse and two Skeletons further along and pick up a Stonesword Key. Then, pick up a Smithing Stone [4] - a Skeleton will jump down from the tree when you loot the body. Finally, make sure to jump on the roof of the small buildings to find a corpse that's holding the Black Bow.

After clearing and looting the graveyard, continue forward into a wine cellar. One Leyndell Foot Soldier will ambush you as you walk in, and another four will throw lightning pots at you. Clear the room and pick up the 1x Clarifying Boluses. Up the ladder opens a shortcut to the Avenue Balcony site.

Now head back outside the wine cellar. To the northwest, head down some stairs. You'll see a Putrid Corpse on its knees. Backstab it and jump down to the sewer here first; don't move forward towards the destroyed building or a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit will attack. Look to the right side of the sewer and you'll see another body at the end - loot it to find the Guilty Hood. Turn around and walk towards the opposite side of the sewer where you'll enter a tunnel. You'll encounter some Rats and some bodies that you can pillage to find a Hefty Beast Bone and a Golden Rune [8]. Move forward and look above, you'll see a Fingercreeper on the wall. Shoot it down and kill it. Go up the stairs on the left and head inside a storage room that is guarded by a Leyndell Knight. In this room, you'll see another corpse sitting against a metal door. Loot it to find a Cracked Pot.

If you go out the doorway on the left, you'll be back at the area with the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit. If you have a mage build or are capable of attacking with long-ranged attacks you can bait it by the doorway and attack from inside the storage room. Killing the tree spirit rewards you with a Golden Seed. Once it's dead, loot the bodies in the area to find a Smithing Stone [6] and 15x Golden Arrows.

Head back toward the sewers, but stay left and climb up a ladder. Sneak past or kill the Lesser Omenkiller, which drops the Omensmirk Mask, and activate the Lower Capital Church site of grace. On the bed are Lionel's Set and the Deathbed Dress. Outside is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [6].

Head back to the sewers and continue through the tunnel. On your left will be two Rats, on your right will be a Rat and a Lesser Fingercreeper guarding 4x String. Continue to the left and kill three Lesser Fingercreepers, picking up 8x Poisonbone Darts. One more Lesser Fingercreeper will be on the ceiling to ambush you, then you'll reach a dead end with a Fingercreeper on the wall. Kill it and pick up 1x Lost Ashes of War.

Now go back to the initial fork and follow the other path. There's a Lesser Fingercreeper on the wall, two Crawling Albinaurics, and a dead end on the right. At the end is a Broken Statue, which you can easily kill as you've snuck up behind it.

In front of the Broken Statue, you'll find a pit, jump down and loot the bodies to find a Holyproof Dried Liver, an Erdsteel Dagger, and 5x Fan Daggers. Once you've grabbed all the items, climb up the tall ladder to find yourself back on the capital's grounds. Check the stairs on the left for 1x Dragonwound Grease. Turn around and you'll see three Leyndell Knights, one with a large bow and the other two wielding a sword and large shield. There's a Leyndell Soldier sitting around as well. Defeat them and loot a Golden Rune [9] from a body on the balcony fence. Continue straight and you'll be back at the Avenue Balcony Site.

Avenue Balcony - Eastern Exit

Go back to the long road with the carriages where the Erdtree Avatar spawned at the northeast section of the capital grounds, and open the large doors at the Easternmost end. Beyond the doors is a section of the capital that is flooded with sand and gravel. This part of the capital grounds is guarded by Misbegotten, and some Rotten Strays.

Upon entering, you may want to check this area first (specifically the southeast section), before you head up the stairs. You'll encounter Misbegotten and Rotten Stray enemies here and find some corpses along the way that you can loot to find items such as 3x Beast Blood, a Golden Rune [9], and a Lightningproof Dried Liver. At the end of the path, you'll encounter a larger Misbegotten and another Rotten Stray. There is another body from where the enemies are standing, loot it to find a Perfume Bottle - upon clearing this section, go back and head up the stairs.

As you head up the stairs, you'll encounter a group of Misbegotten, two Perfumers, and a larger Misbegotten. Kill all the hostile characters and don't forget to flood the corpses by the stairs and the tombstones to find items such as 3x Nascent Butterfly and 1x Exalted Flesh. You'll notice that at the top of the stairs, it's a small graveyard section where you'll encounter more Misbegotten. Check the northwest side, go to the end, and you'll find another corpse you can pillage to obtain 2x Soporific Grease, be cautious when you loot the body since a large Misbegotten next to it will attack you. To the northeast is a lower section with a Misbegotten praying to a statue. Behind the statue is a Somber Smithing Stone (6).

Upon clearing the north portion, check the south side and you'll find an entrance that leads to a small debate room. Pull the lever that's on the podium and this will take you to the upper section of the capital. Go up the stairs, kill the Leyndell Foot Soldiers and Leyndell Soldiers, and by the arch doorway, on the left, loot the body to find the Flamedrake Talisman +1. At this point, the path ahead is blocked by a seal that is placed by Morgott, so you'll have to go back first.

Avenue Balcony - Subterranean Sewers

From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, head down the stairs. Sneak past or kill the three Leyndell Knights, then head down the stairs behind the dragon wing. The first area has 1x Somber Smithing Stone [6] and some Gravel Stone. Jump up the ruined buildings and piles of ash to reach the second area. There is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Thunderbolt, but be wary of the three crawling Albinaurics that will attack you as you go for the scarab. Loot the 1x Smithing Stone [5] and 1x Albinauric Bloodclot from the area. Proceed down a narrow tunnel and kill the Albinauric to pick up 3x Pickled Turtle Neck overlooking where you fight the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Return to the ruined plaza and climb down the ladder in the well.

Continue through and kill or run past the five Rats to arrive in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds.

Avenue Balcony - Southwestern Avenue

From the Avenue Balcony site, go up the stairs, turn right from the doorway and proceed southwest. You should see two Leyndell Soldiers by the steps and a Leyndell Knight that is guarding a door. Kill the enemies and make sure to loot the corpses on the stairs to find items such as a Golden Rune [8], a Golden Rune [12], and 2x Lightningproof Dried Liver. The door cannot be interacted with so go back down, turn right, and move towards the section ahead where you'll spot another Leyndell Soldier and a Leyndell Knight that's sitting under a tree and bonfire. Careful with this knight since it is wielding a large bow. Check the gazebo on the right side that is being guarded by a Perfumer, you'll see a ladder that goes down to the sewers. Head down and kick down a ladder to find yourself at the Lower Capital Church site of grace.

Avenue Balcony - Dragon Wing

After clearing the avenue balcony section, you'll notice that you're right by the wing of the giant ancient dragon corpse. You can actually jump on and climb it. As you climb to the top, you'll find some materials here such as some Gravel Stone. Hike to the top and then jump towards the destroyed wall of a building on the left. You should see another corpse that you can pillage to acquire a Rune Arc. Climb up the ladder that's in front and go up the stairs. At the top is another Leyndell Knight. Kill it and loot the corpse that's near the spot where the knight was standing to find 5x Gravel Stone.

As you enter the arch doorway, prepare to dodge or ready your shield to avoid getting hit by the Leyndell Foot Soldier that will ambush you. Kill the enemy, loot another corpse here to find a Golden Rune [11], continue forward and you'll find the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace.

West Capital Rampart

Continue south from the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace, follow the inlaid stairs downward and check the right side, there's a body here that you can loot to find the Cane Sword. Turn around and exit the arch doorway facing north, on the other side, you should find two Oracle Envoy on the right and one on the left. Kill them, loot the Golden Rune [9], and pull the lever to open the large gate below you. Now go back up to the site of grace.

Up ahead, you'll notice a Valiant Gargoyle. The placement of stairs here makes this fight an awkward one. Once defeated, it drops the Gargoyle's Halberd. There are also three Oracle Envoys nearby. Kill the enemies and pick up a Golden Seed from the glowing sapling.

West Capital Rampart - Abandoned Roundtable Hold

Looking back toward the site of grace, you'll see a set of stairs that goes down. Beware the Page enemy that's hidden next to the stairs. Exit the room on the left and you'll see another body that's hanging on a ledge -- loot it to find a Smithing Stone [6]. Jump down to the roof of a stable and investigate the south side first where you'll encounter three Rotten Strays. In this section, you'll notice a large root that is protruding from the ground leading back toward the gargoyle from earlier. Loot a Golden Rune [9] from the roof of a stable.

On this roof, look to your left, and you'll see an arched doorway leading to an armory. Go inside, and in the next room pick up the Sanctified Whetblade and Hammer on the floor. From the room on the left, loot a Hero's Rune [1] and the "By My Sword" Gesture. Exit the bedroom and continue left. Pick up a Rune Arc from the table. Open the door into the room where the Two Fingers would be and loot the Coded Sword. Go to Gideon Ofnir's office and loot a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.

Proceed to the library Dung Eater sits in, and loot a Seedbed Curse. Go back to the main room and check the balcony for a Smithing Stone [5]. Finally, return to the section where you usually see Smithing Master Hewg and Roderika. Go down to the stairs -- note that they are broken. Loot the Smithing Stone [6] before jumping down. Make a hard left, and go to the dining room. Here you'll find 20x Black-Key Bolts and the Two Fingers' Prayerbook. Enter the kitchen and kill the three Commoners if you like.

Now retrace your steps and enter the main hall. Pillage the corpse in the center of the hall to acquire all of the Armor pieces for the Alberich's Set. If you've been following the Volcano Manor questline, you'll see a red summon sign here as well. Next, check the commoner's quarters which are on the right side of the main hall. In the armory, check behind the weapons to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed further where you'll find the Fortified Manor, First Floor Site of Grace and the Flightless Bird Painting in the bedroom.

Before leaving the main hall, on the left side is a door which can be opened. There are two patrolling Abductor Virgins that can be kited back to the doors to the hall, which they can't get through. In the yard a Stormhawk Axe can be looted and 3x Nascent Butterfly. On the other side of the hallway a Somber Smithing Stone [6] can be found on a corpse. At the opposite end of the yard is a lift, which leads to the Divine Bridge Site of Grace - the same place that you get teleported to from the Tower of Return. If you haven't already looted it, the Blessed Dew Talisman can be found from a chest in here, and on the opposite end is a sending gate that leads to the Isolated Divine Tower, but we won't be going there now.

As you go back out the entrance of the main hall to the city street, turn left and you'll see pair of Leyndell Knights ahead - one on the ground and another on an elevated platform with a Greatbow. Kill the bottom Leyndell Knight and it should drop the Gravel Stone Seal. After dispatching these enemies, check the stable on the right to find another corpse you can loot, the body has 5x Old Fangs.

Look to the left, jump on the dragon's claw, and use it to jump onto the roof of the nearby stable. From there, sprint jump so that you can reach the small guardhouse. Inside, there are two bodies that you can pillage to find a Smithing Stone [6] and a Stonesword Key. Don't forget to check behind the large claws, you'll find another corpse with 3x Gravel Stones.

At this point, head back up the ash-covered road, fighting one Rotten Stray, to the large root protruding from the ground. Climb up the root and return to the West Capital Rampart site of grace.

West Capital Rampart - Erdtree Sanctuary

From the West Capital Rampart site of grace, head out towards the large root. First, go around and under it and and take the stairs up. Head uphill to the right and fight a Duelist. At the top is a large building with another Duelist. Pick up the Ritual Shield Talisman and then head around to the left to find Goldmask and Corhyn (if you've been following their quest) and the Star Fist. Around the right side of the building is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Head back down the hill to the large root and start climbing it.

As you work your way up, you will encounter multiple Guardians. You'll normally find them sitting and they appear to have roots and branches growing from their bodies. Although the path here is quite linear, make sure to check the west side of this large tree, you'll find a path that you can quickly check where you'll encounter some Miranda Sprouts, and as you reach the dead-end, there's a body that you can pillage to find a Smithing Stone [6]. Also, as you're about to reach the top, walk on one of the large branches that's connecting to a narrow roof, also on the left side, there's another body on the roof that you can pillage to acquire 3x Holy Grease - upon reaching the top, enter the room of the cathedral and you'll trigger a boss battle against a specter of Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Go to the boss page for Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Golden Shade) for a description of the fight and strategies.

After defeating him, you'll acquire a Talisman Pouch and 80000 Runes, and the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace will spawn in the arena. After the battle, exit the arena to the sourtheast and walk to the gazebo to pick up 6x Holy Grease. Then check the northwest corner of the arena for 3x Somber Smithing Stone [5]. Head outside via the western doorway and ride the lift down to reach the rest of the capital.

Upper Leyndell

Head down more stairs you'll see a developer message and a large statue. See Brother Corhyn's quest for what to do with this. Down more stairs and you'll encounter two Perfumer enemies. Kill them, then loot 5x Holy Grease. As you continue around the corner, be prepared to attack the invisible Teardrop Scarab. It will run away when you approach and you'll notice the golden tracks it leaves behind. A sprinting attack or spell like Glintblade Phalanx should work to kill it, dropping the Barrier of Gold incantation. Continue northeast towards the stairs, but be ready to fight the lesser Crucible Knight Ordovis that's patrolling. On the way back, look to your right (northwest direction) to notice an item on the golden giant-spear-shaped structure. You can jump safely onto the balcony below you, which lets you get onto the spear. Carefully jump up the spear's contours and you'll eventually acquire the Bolt of Gransax. You can then drop onto the roof of the gazebo below you for another Stonesword Key.

Teleport back to the Erdtree Sanctuary site and continue your exploration of the capital. From the site, head outside the balcony, and proceed northeast. As you walk along the runway, turn right and you'll see another branch of the tree, connecting to the second floor of the sanctuary. Head outside onto a bridge with many corpses of elderly Finger Reader Crones. Turn left immediately and jump out onto the roof below. Climb through the window and loot the Erdtree Bow from the chest, a Celestial Dew, and the Golden Order Principia from the tree root over the sanctuary.

Return to the bridge and continue forward. At the top of the stairs, there is a Black Knife Assassin, sitting by the doorway. After defeating the assassin, enter the chamber and you'll find the Queen's Chamber site, as well as another Incantation spell, the Blessing of the Erdtree. Make sure to rest and make further preparations before you fight the next boss, Morgott, the Omen King.

Boss Battle: Morgott, the Omen King

Go to the boss page for Morgott, the Omen King for a description of the fight and strategies.

Successfully defeating Morgott, the Omen King rewards you with Morgott's Great Rune, the Remembrance of the Omen King, and 120000 Runes (90000 if Melina was summoned for the fight).

Beyond the Barrier

After defeating Morgott, you have no choice but to advance into the Erdtree, and notice that its impenetrable thorns are denying you entry. Turn back and rest at the Site of Grace in the boss arena that's just appeared. Melina will appear and she will hand you the Rold Medallion, and you'll get a red marker that shows you the way forward. With Morgott defeated, the seal that was blocking the path that you previously encountered where the section is guarded by Misbegotten can now be explored.

To quickly get there, fast travel to the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, head out onto the main street where you previously fought the Erdtree Avatar, then turn left and follow it to the large double doors. Exit through them and take the uphill path on your left, and you'll reach an elevator that was previously inaccessible. Ride it to the top, fight off a few soldiers along the way, and be wary of the two Leyndell Knights up ahead. Defeat both, and nearby is a corpse that you can loot to find an Invigorating White Cured Meat. By the broken statue, you'll also find a Teardrop Scarab, killing it will cause it to grow in size and regaining its HP. Make sure to quickly kill it and get a Somber Smithing Stone (6).

Continue along the path and enter the tower on the other side. You then have two possible exits. Through the southern door of this tower, you will go on a bridge that leads to the Divine Tower of East Altus - however, be aware that the Fell Twins will ambush you on the way. Take this route to unlock the power of Morgott's Great Rune. If you ride the lift down, you'll formally arrive at the Forbidden Lands and the next Site of Grace.

Before you continue, ride the lift back up again, face southwest, and keep an eye out for a passageway in the elevator shaft. You can jump into that passageway mid-ride, and find the Official's Attire on a body in a chair right before a door where you will find the Blade of Calling in the room at the end.

Next: Crumbling Farum Azula
